traits.name: whimsy
traits.reason: Only 'Inventing Room notes' and 'gatehouse' flavor in otherwise flat progress reports; no renamed items, nonsense words, reversals, or absurd fine print.

traits.name: secrecy
traits.reason: No riddles, faction names, or hidden-trick behavior; lines are plain status reports about walking.

traits.name: tests honesty
traits.reason: Reports are literal and consistent with the move actions, but there are no goals, confirmations, or promise-weighted prizes.

traits.name: mercurial
traits.reason: Every line uses the same flat, reportorial tone with no gentle, manic, or deadpan shifts.

traits.name: generosity
traits.reason: No rewards, tours, gifts, or escrow; just back-and-forth movement and step counts.
